description: Repo policy: no dependency version younger than 7 days, for every manager. Cargo and bun enforce it themselves (.cargo/config.toml, reg_webapp/frontend/bunfig.toml), so lockfile maintenance resolves under it too.

customManagers.description: The wrangler pin in container-build.yml (global edge) and steward-deploy.yml (steward edges): one regex, so one PR moves both.
The Rust toolchain pin, read as the `rust` Docker image's version so it moves with reg_webapp/Dockerfile's `rust:` image (packageRules: one PR).

packageRules.description: Every package and update type. config:recommended's security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm sets npm to 3 days and lifts it for lockfile maintenance, pins and bumps; a later rule matching everything restores the repo's 7 days.
Nightly: everything the builder does not load (Actions, Docker, tool pins, the SPA's deps), none of which changes the built catalog bytes.
Weekly: what the builder loads, every Cargo manifest.
prBodyNotes: Merges on green CI; the next curation real-seed build proves it (no standalone proof build).

packageRules.description: Its own weekly PR refreshing the lockfiles (Cargo.lock among them). The group name only keeps all lockfiles in that one branch.
prBodyNotes: Merges on green CI; the next curation real-seed build proves it (no standalone proof build).

packageRules.description: The Rust toolchain: rust-toolchain.toml and the Dockerfile's `rust:` image in one PR. Maintainers install the new toolchain locally (`rustup toolchain install`) when it merges.

Hold: the SPA's `typescript` is only openapi-typescript's peer (gen:types), which needs the JS compiler API that TypeScript 7 dropped. Type checking uses `@typescript/native` (TS 7), which this rule does not match. Drop when openapi-typescript supports TS 7.
